chains.name: Singe
chains.description: [Ablaze Prairie] no longer requires full energy to cast. In [Burnout] state, Yanyan's total damage dealt to enemies with [Burn] marks increases by 20%.

chains.name: Energy Overflowing
chains.description: At the start of the battle, Yanyan gains 10 energy.

buffs.description:
Yanyan enters the [Burnout] state. The ultimate can only be activated when energy is full. Activation does not consume energy, and there is a cooldown period after each use. In this state, Yanyan loses 4 energy per second and no longer naturally recovers energy over time. When using this ultimate again or when Yanyan's energy reaches zero, she will exit the [Burnout] state.
[Burnout]: Yanyan receives a ?% Normal Attack Damage boost. Her normal attack now prioritizes enemies with the [Burn] mark, dealing an additional damage equivalent to ?% of the total damage all the [Burn] marks on the enemy is supposed to cause during the effective period. After that, she removes all the [Burn] marks on the enemy.
